a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until 8 almost certainly kills us both, since reaching 8 needs about 2 storm-free rounds (roughly a 4% chance). I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you take too, the split is random. If I end up with any surplus later, I'll give it back to the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would, which breaks our agreement. I'm sorry. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so you can build the reserve up to 4. I'll also give back anything over 4 that I end up holding.
